comments.body: Reserved docs/design/contract-compatibility.md, src/Contracts and tests/Contracts for the versioned envelope policy. I will define additive optional metadata, must-understand extensions, fail-closed major-version handling and an explicit lossless migration example. Verification will exercise both old/new readers and rejection fixtures. CLI registration, desktop components, shared planning files and research worktrees are outside this change.

Merged in #187. Locked restore and all 18 xUnit cases passed on the development Linux host. Windows and Linux CI also passed at https://github.com/ameenalqershi/wow-decision-intelligence/actions/runs/46016962352 . M01, M03, M09 and extension consumers can now reference the compatibility policy. Domain payload validation, authorization and plugin isolation retain separate owners.

Reserved src/DecisionGraph, tests/DecisionGraph and docs/design/decision-graph.md. The scope is an immutable, revision-scoped graph of typed entities and hyperedges, including complete constraint incidence, capacity, time windows and provenance. Verification will cover invalid references, duplicate identities, revision isolation and a constraint over multiple variables. Cross-revision impact indexing remains #15.

#188 merged the graph snapshot contract and its field specification. The 16 xUnit cases passed locally and in the Linux and Windows graph jobs at https://github.com/ameenalqershi/wow-decision-intelligence/actions/runs/46017922866 . The independent planning and research checks also passed. Scope completeness of bound expressions remains a compiler responsibility. #15 can consume revision identities and complete incident hyperedges.

Reserved src/DecisionGraph/RevisionImpact.cs, tests/DecisionGraph/RevisionImpactTests.cs and docs/design/revision-impact.md. The comparison uses old and new incidence, includes deleted and newly introduced scopes, and refuses comparisons across tenants/models. I will compare indexed closure with an independent full-scan oracle on seeded graph revisions. A reachability result cannot certify mathematical reuse.

### Traceability record

Issue M02 · Independent scope · P0 · MVP · high risk.

Requirements: REQ-M02.

Design: `docs/design/engine.md`. Diagram: `docs/design/operating-modes.md`.

Fields: No approved field mapping in this baseline. Contracts: No approved API mapping in this baseline.

Direct consumers: #39 (X02), #72 (U03), #94 (UI05), #118 (CLI06).

Required evidence: TC-M02-A — Compare incremental reachability to complete traversal including deleted and newly introduced edges and global objectives.

Verification: Execute the linked acceptance cases and attach observed evidence to the issue. Planning: `dotnet run --project tools/Traceability`. Keep scope within the deliverable above. Review downstream contracts and publish feature-specific evidence before closing.

Merged in #189. All 22 graph tests passed on Linux and Windows, including six revision-impact cases and 128 seeded comparisons with an independent full traversal. Added/deleted global coupling and removed IDs are covered. Results are conservative potential impact; the reuse certificate belongs to #39. No runtime speedup is claimed.

Reserved docs/design/udir-v1.md, src/Udir and tests/Udir. I will freeze the wire fields, original-source spans, exact-rational rules, graph references, uncertainty and objective contracts before implementing the checked representation. The parser, unit conversion engine, numerical lowering and native solver adapters remain separate issues. Verification will round-trip a source-linked factory fixture and reject invalid identities, cycles, domains, stages and versions.

Merged in #207. The versioned C# model, field contract, original source fixture and round-trip tests are now on main. UDIR preserves exact rational bounds/literals, typed expression and objective structure, source spans, scenario overrides, currency, time basis and required capabilities.

The final PR revision passed all five jobs. 42/42 UDIR tests passed separately on Ubuntu and Windows, with zero skips or failures: https://github.com/ameenalqershi/wow-decision-intelligence/actions/runs/46057982251 . Research and live ledger checks: https://github.com/ameenalqershi/wow-decision-intelligence/actions/runs/46057982172 .

With M03 landed, the ledger prerequisites for #17, #18, #23, #24, #26 and #48 are satisfied. #22 also needs #17; #29 and #136 also need #26. Mathematical feasibility, conversion policy and solver admission remain with their owning scopes.

Reserved src/Udir/MeasurementSemantics.cs, tests/Udir/MeasurementSemanticsTests.cs and docs/design/measurement-semantics.md. Scope covers dimension checking of typed operations, exact unit scale conversion, explicit versioned FX and time-basis compatibility, including overflow and DST boundary cases. Downstream SDK and compiler consumers can use the checked boundary.

M10 #23 claimed in a separate worktree. It consumes the merged M03 UDIR contract as-is; no changes to your unit semantics or future SDK. JSON Schema validates wire shape; M03 validates structural domain semantics, and M04 remains authoritative for dimensional validation.

Owner-directed integration assistance: resolving #210 against latest main in a separate detached integration worktree. Existing claim and original worktree remain untouched. Will preserve M04 semantics and all merged requirement changes, rerun downstream import and UDIR checks, and update PR only with a fast-forward based on the exact reviewed head.

Integrated #210 after resolving the requirements conflict and refreshing only the Studio matrix hash. Final hosted CI 13/13 passed, including UDIR, import and conformance on Windows/Linux, PostgreSQL and Studio review. Local regression 107/107. Existing M04 implementation unchanged. The merge is verified in main.

Studio dependency coordination: #18 is currently unclaimed and blocks #19/#20 and downstream visual/DML Studio. The owner directive permits a coordinated transfer, but this remains engine-owned until explicitly assigned. Please confirm responsibility transfer or your implementation plan; I will not claim M05/M06 unilaterally.

Explicit owner directive now transfers M05/M06 compiler execution to the SDK/runtime workstream. Checked both issues unassigned/backlog with no reservation tags or worktrees. This resolves the prior Studio coordination question. Reserving #18 now; #19 only after M05 acceptance. Manufacturing/scenario and Studio owners: please keep these compiler scopes exclusive to this workstream.

Reserved syntax-only scope src/Dml.Syntax, tests/Dml.Syntax, docs/design/dml-syntax-v1.md; no UDIR/compiler/solver changes. M05 covers lexical grammar, source-linked AST, bounded syntax parsing and stable diagnostics, version/extension policy. M06 owns binding and semantic lowering remains separate. Verification: locked restore, dotnet test tests/Dml.Syntax -c Release, Traceability, Windows/Linux CI.

TC-M05-A accepted: #221 merged after 5/5 hosted checks (actual Windows/Linux parser suites); 32/32 Linux tests normally and offline, 2,000 deterministic fuzz cases, no partial AST on failure, stable spans/codes and explicit extension policy. Shared UDIR unchanged. Binding and semantic admission remain #19/#20.

Project owner expanded SDK/compiler responsibility to this workstream: M05/M06 (#18/#19) are assigned here for sequential execution. Coordination notice to manufacturing/scenario and Studio owners: please do not reserve these two scopes; retain your manufacturing, scenario and visualization work. #19 will be claimed only after #18 closes. Existing reservations elsewhere are untouched.

Reserved M06 in src/Dml.Binding, tests/Dml.Binding and docs/design/dml-binding-v1.md. Consume merged M05 AST; bind references against explicit model symbols and trusted source alias manifest, reject duplicate IDs, derived cycles and unsupported executable syntax, retain all original source/trigger/window/policy/scenario facts. No external I/O or arithmetic normalization here; M07 owns semantic admission and canonical lowering. Locked restore, tests, Traceability and platform CI.

TC-M06-A completed: #223 merged with all five hosted checks successful, including Windows/Linux binding suites. 27/27 normal and isolated-network tests, 4,000-definition iterative traversal, source-linked cycle diagnostics, authorized alias validation and executable construct rejection. Original AST and all reference spans retained. M07 owns exact semantics and normalization.

Reserved M07 in src/Dml.Semantics, tests/Dml.Semantics and docs/design/dml-semantics-v1.md. Consume M04/M06 and canonical UDIR unchanged; exact semantic admission and normalization with original source/rewrite lineage. Coordinate with M08/M12 and S04, no solver or verifier replacement. Independent finite-domain equivalence tests. Unsupported operational/uncertainty semantics must remain explicit or fail closed.

Draft #224 contains the exact UDIR normalization foundation (8/8 normal/offline tests; 25 finite assignments independently checked). Bound DML-to-UDIR admission, operational/scenario semantics and full frontend equivalence remain to be completed. No closure or downstream claim based on this partial implementation.

TC-M07-A completed for the explicitly admitted mathematical profile: 41/41 normal and isolated Linux tests, 56 exhaustive finite assignments across three independent checks (including real S04 original-model checks on 13 workforce assignments). All 5 hosted checks passed Windows/Linux. Unsupported operational windows/trigger/dependency semantics fail closed, never silently removed. Exact UDIR, source lineage and frozen fact digest preserved. See merged #224 and design documentation. No native solver or scenario verification qualification implied.

Reserved M08 in src/Dml.Lowering, tests/Dml.Lowering and docs/design/solver-lowering-v1.md; reuse M07 exact arithmetic through an internal compiler seam, S01 capability manifest unchanged. Lower a conservative affine profile with exact scaling, source-index maps and reconstruction metadata. Reject unsupported domains/features/rows, rounding and overflow before any adapter call. Coordinate with S02/S03/S06 and independent S04; no native adapter or verification implementation here.

Draft #227: exact affine matrix and source-index reconstruction implemented, 11/11 normal/offline checks including 25 exhaustive assignments. The proposed continuous capability token rational.linear and native numerical limits need S03/S06 owner review; no approval or adapter qualification inferred. Int64 and exact binary64 input are separate encodings. Retain #21 active until reviewed.

TC-M08-A complete: merged #227 at 23e6073 after 9/9 hosted checks and 11/11 local/offline cases, including 25 finite assignments. Exact scale/source index/reconstruction mapping, no rounding, qualified-feature gate. Coordination on #27/#28/#31. Native execution and independent proof remain separate.

M04 #17 is now merged via #210; formal dependencies #16 and #17 are closed. The SDK may use UdirDocument.ValidateMeasurements with the frozen MeasurementSemantics catalog. Full TC-M09-A DML equivalence must be qualified with actual M06/M07 parser and normalization (#19/#20), not a hand-authored substitute; this is an acceptance seam, not a change to the approved dependency ledger.

Reserved M09 in src/ModelingSdk, tests/ModelingSdk and docs/design/modeling-sdk.md. Consume existing UdirDocument, MeasurementSemantics and ModelImport contracts, no engine/compiler changes. Typed unit expressions and deterministic source-linked revision construction; actual DML normalized equivalence remains dependent on M06/M07 outputs (#19/#20) and will not be substituted by manually authored IR.

SDK implementation and both executable examples are in draft #216. 21/21 tests normal/offline, compile-negative CS0411, byte-identical normal/offline UDIR outputs. TC-M09-A actual normalized DML equivalence requires the real parser/binder and normalizer (#19/#20; grammar #18). No closure or fake equivalence.

M07 #224 is merged at 6a52c73 and #20 is closed. Extending the claimed SDK scope with explicit frozen baseline facts (S04 flat exact-value snapshot), independent DML and JSON input fixtures, shared normalization and differential comparison of canonical bytes AND actual fact/catalog inputs. No changes to shared wire or verifier contracts.

Reserved src/ModelRegistry, tests/ModelRegistry, docs/design/model-registry.md and their CI workflow. Scope is the durable SQLite reference registry for immutable tenant/model/revision snapshots with original source bytes and digest verification, transactional replay/concurrent commits and schema migration. Enterprise EF Core and local workspace hosting consume the registry boundary separately. Verification includes reopening a database across migration and concurrent writer scenarios.

Merged through #209. All 18 SQLite integration cases passed on Ubuntu and Windows. The seeded v1 migration preserves the original trusted revisions and a failed upgrade rolls back. Local runtime and enterprise persistence can now consume the immutable model registry. The pull request contains both platform runs and the live ledger check.

Reserved M12 in src/Dml.Presolve, tests/Dml.Presolve and docs/design/safe-presolve.md. Consume merged M07 normalized UDIR, retain original revision, remove only constant-true hard rows and identical hard predicates, reconstruct unused variables using admissible exact domain witnesses; retain soft rows and explicit contradictions. No solver/verification changes. Test projection and reconstruction by exhaustive finite enumeration; fail closed on unsupported scenario semantics.

TC-M12-A verified: 5/5 local/offline tests and all 5 hosted checks, 125 original and 25 projected assignments with exact lift, objective and soft-row equivalence. Original revision and contradiction spans retained. Projection API is standalone; execution integration remains downstream.

Reserved src/Solver.Contracts, tests/Solver.Contracts, docs/design/solver-contract.md and their CI workflow. The contract covers the adapter manifest, mathematical and termination statuses, original-revision identity, incumbent, directed objective bounds, tolerances, trust source and measured resources. Adapter execution, admission policy and independent verification remain separate. Locked xUnit fixtures will exercise both objective directions and unavailable measurements.

Merged through #208. All 21 solver-contract tests passed on Ubuntu and Windows. #29, #32 and #136 can consume the published contract. The pull request contains both platform runs and the live ledger check.

M08 #227 provides exact finite affine lowering to Int64, with explicit integer.linear domain capability, exact source/native row mappings and objective offset/scale reconstruction. Native scheduling/global constraints are not covered by the affine profile. S02 must independently qualify CP-SAT runtime, stricter native bounds and scheduling semantics through R07; do not advertise those features from this managed lowering.

M08 #227 defines rational.linear as an explicit lowering admission capability for continuous affine domains. Binary64ExactInput accepts only exactly representable inputs and does not establish exact backend computation or bounds. S03 must advertise it only after actual HiGHS qualification and independently assess tolerance, evidence and native bounds. No silent rounding.

NUM01 regression confirms M08 admits exact binary64 input for rational.linear but S04/S05 currently reject that mandatory capability. Coordinate the approved continuous verification/tolerance profile with the verifier owner before accepting any HiGHS evidence. Do not strip capability declarations. No existing verification source changed.

Scope: src/Verification.Independent, tests/Verification.Independent, docs/design/independent-verification.md and dedicated CI. Independently evaluate original UDIR exact domains/expressions/constraints/objectives; no compiler/lowering/solver implementation dependencies or shared schema changes. Reject unsupported semantics rather than attest feasibility. Test finite enumeration and source-model counterexamples.

Draft #220 / ed9e9f4. 10/10 local tests, 242 start pairs against independent tick-by-tick oracle, 15 exact capacity/cost candidates, original scope/fact and objective verification. No solver/lowering calls. Staged uncertainty remains unsupported because S01 single assignment lacks recourse semantics; pilot source mapping is internal and not yet qualified with V01/M10. Keep Active for full review and integration evidence.

V01 integration update: 1f28b72 replaces provisional factory DTOs with Manufacturing.Data FactoryAdmission and the frozen source contract. Local Release: 14/14 tests, including all four V01 fixtures, exact rational multi-material cost and no-stock rejection. S04 does not depend on Dispatch/lowering. Scenario-specific recourse remains explicitly unsupported by S01; source selection must be bound by host. New CI pending.

Merged #220: TC-S04-A and DIR-S04-1 original witness checker for deterministic UDIR/1 and admitted V01 source. 14/14 tests on each Linux and Windows, 242 start pairs vs independent tick oracle, four actual V01 datasets, exact rational/assignment/capacity/interval/objective checks without lowering. No claim of optimality, scenario recourse or unrelated UDIR rows from pilot-only verification. M10/V03/S12 select authoritative frozen source; S05/S10 classify and persist verified evidence. All five hosted checks passed and merge was clean.

NUM01 cross-contract audit: M08 exact lowering supports rational.linear; OriginalVerifier currently explicitly rejects it. Continuous domains can be evaluated in the existing integer.linear profile, but removing rational.linear would misrepresent the model. Please coordinate an explicit qualified continuous verification profile with S03 and S05; this is a downstream extension, not an assertion that the closed S04 acceptance was false.

Scope: src/Verification.Bounds, tests/Verification.Bounds, design evidence-strength and dedicated CI. Consume original UDIR/S04 and S01; independent bounded enumeration proof and precise direction/scope/evidence classification, no solver/lowering changes. Reject unsupported proof profiles. Verify negative cases and exact arithmetic.

PR #229 / b97b984: 8/8 local tests, exact original-model enumeration for bounded integer/Boolean domains, both directions, 25-point negative two-variable oracle, full infeasibility, stale context and forged certificates. Profile does not accept LP dual, staged or multiobjective certificates. Await Linux/Windows CI; no closure before verification.

Merged #229 after all five hosted checks passed. TC-S05-A fulfilled by complete original-model finite enumeration, both objective directions, exact gaps, stale model/facts/catalog/run rejection and solver attestation distinction. 8/8 on Linux and Windows plus 14/14 S04 regression locally. No LP dual, staged or multiobjective certificate claim; unsupported profile fails closed. Scope, capability, reported bound and proof algorithm retained for S10.

NUM01 cross-contract audit: EvidenceClassifier rejects rational.linear and uses exact original-model comparisons; continuous adapter evidence needs an explicit reviewed profile with tolerance-qualified observations distinct from exact proof. Coordinate with S03/S04 before native integration. Existing closed S05 scope unchanged.

M08 #227 provides ExactLowerer.Lower and explicit integer.linear / rational.linear affine admission. Planning should use actual qualified manifests plus lowering admission, not feature names alone, and preserve exact-vs-numeric execution and rejection diagnostics. Native qualification remains R07.

Reserved S06 in src/Solver.Planning, tests/Solver.Planning, docs/design/solver-planning.md. Consume S01 manifest and merged M08 exact lowering, deterministic capability/budget-first policy over host-supplied qualified adapter profiles, rejection evidence and stable tie-break. No native execution, no new shared wire contracts, no UADIE heuristic or evidence verification. Qualification remains R07/S02/S03.

TC-S06-A completed: #230 merged following 5/5 local and isolated-network policy tests and 5/5 hosted checks (Windows/Linux). Actual M08 lowering admission, worker budget, deterministic preference and tie-break, per-profile rejections. No native qualification or optimizer outcome is claimed. R07/S02/S03 still gate production execution.

Scope: src/Runtime.Governance, tests/Runtime.Governance, docs/design/worker-governance.md and dedicated CI. Implement S07 bounded fair scheduling, resource reservation, native process supervision and fenced publication authority. Read S01 contract; do not implement solver/compiler or modify E02/S12 schemas. Actual subprocess and competing tenant tests; durable distributed worker lease integration remains coordinated with S12/E03. Document OS guarantees and limitations.

Draft #217 / 8cf09f4. 13 local scheduler and actual fixture subprocess tests passed; actual platform containment tests configured separately for Linux delegated cgroup v2 and Windows Job Objects. Shared server CPU controller not delegated; no local kernel enforcement claim. No scope/solver/DB changes. Await hosted checks; keep Active.

First hosted run: Linux delegated cgroup suite passed; Windows three tests failed due empty inherited stdout under CreateNoWindow. Explicit bounded-buffer stdout/stderr pump in trusted bootstrap fixes the observed handle inheritance problem, without weakening output limits or isolation. Rechecking both platforms.

Merged #217 after five hosted checks passed. TC-S07-A: 14 portable tests and four real OS containment tests per Linux/Windows, actual CPU/memory limits, concurrent tenants, crash retry, cancellation, stale fence and reservation cleanup. Local governor scope qualified; durable cross-host lease publication (S12/E03), restricted identity/egress (E07) and deployment policy (E06) remain downstream. No full production deployment claim.

Reopening narrowly for measured integration regression in #79/#222: WorkerProcessBoundary reads Stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds twice for elapsed and reserved core-ms. This can yield inconsistent measurements across a millisecond boundary. Correct the source to capture once and add invariant regression; retain prior qualified OS behavior.

Correction scope only: WorkerProcessBoundary elapsed snapshot and S07 measurement consistency tests. Separate branch; no change to scheduler, OS limits or contracts. Existing #79/#81 consumers may continue their current work; reclose after CI and merge.

Corrected elapsed/core-time consistency in #225. All five hosted checks passed, including Linux/Windows OS resource tests with measurement invariant. Reclosing S07; E05 integrated rerun remains in #222.

Scope: src/Verification.Evidence and tests/Verification.Evidence, independent evidence envelope, reproducible replay, immutable local evidence store linked to M11, design and dedicated CI. S10 does not own S12 public routes or E02 shared schema. Enterprise storage will consume the same validated evidence bytes via coordinated port. No changes to existing model or solver wire contracts.

PR #233 / 073bf6b: 8/8 actual SQLite tests, exact immutable M11-linked evidence with hashes, solver/build/hardware/invocation/termination/tolerance metadata, independent replay, authorized audit report, portable bounded package, Arabic tenant scope, concurrent retries, rehashed false assessment rejected and quiesced backup/restore. SEC01/S12 must consume the same package for fenced enterprise publication; no duplicate PostgreSQL evidence store. Await Linux/Windows hosted verification.

Merged #233 after all five hosted checks passed, including 8/8 actual SQLite tests on Linux and Windows. TC-S10-A: immutable M11-linked evidence, original hashes, solver/build/hardware/invocation and tolerance metadata, independent replay, structured audit and bounded export, concurrency/conflict, tamper/rollback and quiesced restore. Enterprise publication uses the same package through SEC01/E02/S12; no claim of native rerun or server-side fenced publication.

Delivered and reviewed against the stated scope. Evidence: https://github.com/ameenalqershi/wow-decision-intelligence/blob/3f470d7c25534107e3a4b2dd11fdcbe61fb3d5ab/research/evidence/component-study.json. Related delivery or validation work remains tracked separately.

Design coordination from #89 / #190 and SP02 #160: API-BENCHMARK / UI19. Logical operation, ownership, validation and acceptance boundaries are documented at https://github.com/ameenalqershi/wow-decision-intelligence/blob/work/89-audit-evidence/docs/design/specialized-studio-ports-v1.md . Please review the applicable profile and confirm concrete versioned fields, provider limits, error/retry semantics and feature-specific test evidence before binding production UI. This is a design baseline, not a claim that the provider or wire schema is complete. Existing ownership and reservations are unchanged.

Delivered and reviewed against the stated scope. Evidence: https://github.com/ameenalqershi/wow-decision-intelligence/blob/3f470d7c25534107e3a4b2dd11fdcbe61fb3d5ab/docs/research/innovation.md. Related delivery or validation work remains tracked separately.

Reserved NUM01 in tests/Numerical.Invariants and docs/design/numerical-invariants.md. Exercise real M04/M07/M08/S04 components, exact finite enumeration, unit scaling and FX, coefficient boundaries, residuals and reproducibility. No native result fabrication or shared semantic changes; native repeat execution remains explicitly conditional on qualification.

Compiler quality coordination: M05 has 2,000 deterministic random inputs, M06 iterative 4,000-definition chain, M07 independent finite enumeration and real S04 checks. QA05 should independently generate bounded source models and compare exact enumeration with actual M08 lowering and S04, preserving minimized regression seeds; it is not closed by these component suites.

Maintainer reservation request for SP05, handle `hypothesis-dossiers`. The dependency #4 is closed. The GitHub connector reaches the issue, but the worktree shell cannot reach GitHub to push the annotated reservation tag. If the remote claim is still available, please reserve #163 on behalf of this session using `bash tools/claim.sh 163 hypothesis-dossiers` and confirm the reservation here. This request alone does not reserve the issue.

Proposed scope: H1–H5 dossiers under `docs/research/`, with the existing comparison protocol and innovation register as inputs. Verification will cover TC-SP05-A/B, counterexamples, independent baselines, falsification criteria and the repository traceability check. No shared schema or runtime changes are requested.

Reservation confirmed for the requested hypothesis-dossiers session. The official claim script completed successfully. Remote annotated tag: work-claims/163 (c47e1b581c56a8390dbe9a6886ec090d6e1fbfe7). Issue status: active; branch: work/163-hypothesis-dossiers; authorized server worktree: /root/wowdi-163-hypothesis-dossiers; base: f814cf3. Scope remains H1–H5 research dossiers and associated verification, as requested. Resume this existing claim; do not run a second claim or overwrite other worktrees. If using another machine, fetch and verify the reservation and coordinate the existing worktree before writing.

Implementation and verification are ready for independent review in #205, commit 02dbf1f929d097009f94659076ed283526d1ac28. The reserved server worktree and the PR contain the same commit. Linux replay passed all five counterexamples, reproduced the 391 comparisons byte-for-byte, and confirmed scheduling costs/bounds of 3 and 12 and the coverage LP bound of 1.5. The PR includes the commands, evidence scope, and TC-SP05-A/B mapping. Please review the five research decisions and the prospective experiment gates before merge. Reservation remains active pending review.

Maintainer acceptance: SP05 is accepted as research dossiers, not a claim of measured superiority. PR #205 merged at cf5b8c4. Independently replayed all six witnesses on Linux and reproduced the 391 comparison evidence byte-for-byte (SHA-256 31809201ac231da3c2aedca80aa693c69073d6dd4110673e3a278409694f1e0c). Reviewed the two corrected promotion criteria and the independent review comment on commit 6f99717; all three hosted checks passed. The downstream EP04 qualification and prospective trials remain separate. Closing with evidence.
